v5.9.20 - Dark mode toggle fix
Fixes --- - Dark mode toggle now persists your choice across app restarts - Manual theme selection no longer resets when the OS theme changes - NativeWind/Tailwind styles follow dark mode reliably - New Dark Mode switch under Settings → MISC (header moon/sun toggle still works)
Includes v5.9.19 settings UI overhaul.
